Dear Demarco Olson,

Thank you for applying for the Director of Finance position at NangoDev.  I would like to set up a time to speak with you on the phone.  Can you please send me your availability over the next few days and the best number to reach you at?

I look forward to speaking with you.

Sincerely,

Natalie Sung

Hi Natalie,

Thank you for your email. It would be great to speak to you and I am available any time this week for a call at your convenience.

Many thanks,

Demarco Olson
Demarco rocked the skill test! We should definitively go ahead and schedule the next interview.

Dear Demarco,

We have reviewed your assessment and are pleased to tell you that you did great! Therefore we would like to invite you for the next steps of the process, which is an interview with the hiring manager. Could you please come back to us and tell us when you are available for a meeting this week?

Thanks in advance,

Natalie

Dear Natalie,

This is very good news!

Best regards,

Demarco Olson

Hi Demarco,

Congratulations on making it to this step of our process for Director of Finance at NangoDev!

We’d like to know more about you, so we prepared an online assessment that will give us a glimpse of you at work. We ask that you please complete it by Monday 27 April 2026, 11:45 PM - Etc/UTC (GMT+00:00).

Here’s an overview:

  • Assessments:
    • Abstract Reasoning
    • Numerical Comprehension
    • Verbal Comprehension
    • Attention & focus
    • Workplace personality
  • Duration: approximately 56 minutes

You can access the assessment below. You’ll find all instructions there. Good luck!

Dear Andrea Manigo,

Thank you for applying for the Director of Finance position at NangoDev.  I would like to set up a time to speak with you on the phone.  Can you please send me your availability over the next few days and the best number to reach you at?

I look forward to speaking with you.

Sincerely,

Natalie Sung

Hi Natalie,

Thank you for your email. It would be great to speak to you and I am available any time this week for a call at your convenience.

Many thanks,

Andrea Manigo
Andrea did quite well for the test.

Dear Andrea,

We have reviewed your assessment and are pleased to tell you that you did great! Therefore we would like to invite you for the next steps of the process, which is an interview with the hiring manager. Could you please come back to us and tell us when you are available for a meeting this week?

Thanks in advance,

Natalie

Dear Natalie,

This is very good news!

Best regards,

Andrea Manigo

Hi Andrea,

Congratulations on making it to this step of our process for Director of Finance at NangoDev!

We’d like to know more about you, so we prepared an online assessment that will give us a glimpse of you at work. We ask that you please complete it by Wednesday 29 April 2026, 11:45 PM - Etc/UTC (GMT+00:00).

Here’s an overview:

  • Assessments:
    • Abstract Reasoning
    • Numerical Comprehension
    • Verbal Comprehension
    • Attention & focus
    • Workplace personality
  • Duration: approximately 56 minutes

You can access the assessment below. You’ll find all instructions there. Good luck!

Dear Frederique Romaguera,

Thank you for applying for the Director of Finance position at NangoDev.  I would like to set up a time to speak with you on the phone.  Can you please send me your availability over the next few days and the best number to reach you at?

I look forward to speaking with you.

Hi Natalie,

Thank you for your email. It would be great to speak to you and I am available any time this week for a call at your convenience.

Many thanks,

Frederique Romaguera
Frederique did quite well for the test compared to other candidates. Let's get in touch with him to schedule the next step.

Dear Frederique,

We have reviewed your assessment and are pleased to tell you that you did great! Therefore we would like to invite you for the next steps of the process, which is an interview with the hiring manager. Could you please come back to us and tell us when you are available for a meeting this week?

Thanks in advance,

Natalie

Dear Natalie,

This is very good news!

Best regards,

Frederique Romaguera

Hi Frederique,

Congratulations on making it to this step of our process for Director of Finance at NangoDev!

We’d like to know more about you, so we prepared an online assessment that will give us a glimpse of you at work. We ask that you please complete it by Thursday 30 April 2026, 11:45 PM - Etc/UTC (GMT+00:00).

Here’s an overview:

  • Assessments:
    • Abstract Reasoning
    • Numerical Comprehension
    • Verbal Comprehension
    • Attention & focus
    • Workplace personality

You can access the assessment below. You’ll find all instructions there. Good luck!
